stem: What is the main idea of paragraphs 7 and 8?

options.label: A
options.text: When people use speech-recognition applications, their privacy may be invaded.

options.label: B
options.text: As people talk more to computers, they may become less able to interact with humans.

options.label: C
options.text: Advances in technology may cause humans to lose their jobs to computers.

options.label: D
options.text: The use of speech-recognition technology poses a variety of potential problems.
